result.summary: The page looks generally functional with no critical visual defects. One minor layout issue was identified.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol' restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated without an ellipsis, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis or ensure the card width accommodates the full restaurant name, or use a smaller font size to fit the text within the card bounds.
